actions_or_findings.title: IA005-F1-C1 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: deadlocks in _apply bypass the new retry
actions_or_findings.trigger: MySQL 1205 or 1213 occurs while _apply stores analysis or aggregates an incident.
actions_or_findings.rationale: _apply converts SQLAlchemyError, including OperationalError, to AppError. The worker retries only a raw OperationalError, so this path fails without either of the two additional attempts. The new task test injects a raw error at the service boundary and misses this conversion. The saved concurrency result required an operator replay; it does not prove automatic recovery.

actions_or_findings.title: IA005-F1-C2 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: a locked follower can lose its shared capacity charge
actions_or_findings.trigger: A staff action locks the sole active follower while the primary assignment ends or times out.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The successor query uses SKIP LOCKED and can omit that still-active follower. The primary is then cleared and its load released. When the staff action commits, the follower remains active without a capacity owner; its later close also skips load release. Sequential lifecycle evidence and the creation-only concurrency probe do not cover this overlap.

This is operator residue, separate from the product-code blockers.
